newsitem.title: USA: RCSB Financial preliminary Q4 shr $0.62.
newsitem.headline: RCSB Financial preliminary Q4 shr $0.62.

text.p: RCSB Financial Inc said preliminary net income for the fourth quarter was $0.62 per share or $9.6 million, compared to $0.56 per fully diluted share or $10.4 million in the same period last year.

It also said it expected to report net income of about $39.7 million or $2.36 per share for fiscal 1996 compared to $37.8 million or $2.02 per share in 1995. The company's fiscal year ended November 30.
The company said business expansion and share repurchases contributed to the earnings gains.

Chairman Leonard Simon said: "We're pleased with the further gains in RCSB's profitability in 1996...By announcing our financial results on a preliminary basis, we are able to continue our current 1.5 million share repurchase program without interruption."
The company said it expected to report comprehensive results on or about January 29.
